Hi! I’m a fifth-year PhD Student at Carnegie Mellon University in the Department of Statistics and Data Science. I am fortunate to be advised by Jing Lei and Yandi Shen. Previously, I received my Bachelor’s in mathematics at University of Chicago.

title: Yuchen Chen
text:
Research
I am broadly interested in developing theory and methods for evaluating modern learning algorithms. My recent research focuses on two main directions: characterizing the precise dynamics of high-dimensional iterative algorithms using tools from high-dimensional probability, statistical physics and optimization; and developing distribution-free methods for evaluating modern predictive algorithms.
